method: built-in ImageGen edits; first retouch remains foreshortened, second uses a flat composition guide

attempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Correct ONLY the perspective of the stone pedestal in input image 1, the mobile dungeon-heart sprite. Retain the existing dark violet vortex orb, its circular glowing rim, its size relative to pedestal WIDTH, its broad spiral, and the violet energy tether. Image 2 shows the current game floor and is the geometric orientation reference.
Critical correction: the game uses a FLAT 2D SQUARE grid with no foreshortening in its ground plane. The pedestal TOP must therefore appear as a true square in the image, equal depth and width, front/back edges horizontal and side edges vertical. The current pedestal is incorrectly compressed vertically into a shallow rectangle: extend its top surface depth to make a square footprint. Do NOT rotate it into an isometric diamond, do NOT introduce vanishing-point taper, do NOT render a conventional 3/4 camera view. The base must sit on this flat grid.
The circular socket drawn in the horizontal top surface must appear CIRCULAR, not elliptical. The top surfaces of all four short corner stones must appear square with rounded corners, not horizontally flattened. Use the four corner stones as equally sized markers of the square footprint; the floating orb may naturally occlude portions of the rear stones. The orb is a free 2D billboard above the socket, not flattened or perspective-warped.
Give the pedestal only a SHALLOW painted thickness: upper stone edges offset slightly up-left from lower edges; bottom shift approximately one unit right for five down. Thus a narrow front/south facade and a very narrow right/east facade can show, consistent with the game's low masonry. Avoid the tall frontal rows of the old image. No extra tiers.
Keep chunky hand-painted cartoon dark blue-grey stone and rounded corners, localized violet reflected light, low microdetail. The socket remains centered in the square top. Float the orb above and slightly northward in image space so the socket and the front top surface remain visible.
A single complete sprite on genuine transparent background, plenty of transparent margins. No checkerboard, no backdrop, no floor tile, no grid lines, no text or labels. Preserve native glow alpha. Do not add scenery or ornaments. Correct this one sprite; no comparison sheet.

Use case: sketch-to-render / precise-object-edit.
IMAGE 1 is the MANDATORY FLAT SCREEN-SPACE LAYOUT. Paint this exact layout into a polished mobile dungeon-heart sprite. Do not change any of its geometry or proportions. IMAGE 2 is paint/style and vortex appearance reference ONLY; its old foreshortened pedestal perspective is incorrect and MUST NOT be copied. IMAGE 3 is the game environment/palette reference.

The first image intentionally looks straight down onto the stone slab: the slab's top is a SQUARE, its four corner-block tops are SQUARES, and its centered socket is a CIRCLE. Preserve those shapes EXACTLY. Top-plane vertical distances equal horizontal distances. DO NOT compress the top plane vertically or turn the circular socket into an ellipse. DO NOT rotate to isometric, add perspective taper, or change to a three-quarter camera. Keep the same corner positions and full deep square footprint from image 1. The tiny slab front thickness is the only perspective illusion, as drawn in image 1.

Replace flat guide colours with dark blue-grey hand-painted cartoon dungeon stone, broad softly faceted highlights, rounded bevels, large quiet slabs. Add only a few broad stone joints on the square horizontal surface. Keep those joints horizontally/vertically aligned. The four corner stones remain squat, with the shallow visible front edges of image 1. Texture contrast should resemble the current game, not bright photorealistic stone.

Replace the simple spiral circle of image 1 with the beautiful DARK VIOLET VORTEX from image 2, retaining the orb size and location from IMAGE 1. A round floating magical core with one violet glowing rim, 2 broad internal spiral shapes, and the short energy tether into the circular socket. The orb is upright painted 2D art, independent of the flat support plane. Localized violet light on nearby stone, dark mass readable at 160 pixels wide. No fine particle cloud or microdetail.

One sprite, true transparent background including soft alpha glow. Keep the composition and padding of image 1. No text, grid, labels, backdrop, environment, characters or contact-floor patch. This is a strict layout painting task: EXACT SQUARE top plane and EXACT ROUND top socket are the essential correction.
